family: training-standardized representation plus training-standardized Gaussian Nystrom block; ridge with unpenalized intercept; clipping to [0,1]
landmark_selection: distinct raw training histories, first row identities; lexicographic if all fit, otherwise deterministic farthest-first in training-standardized raw coordinates
encoded_landmark_collisions: retain all shared identities and use the common Gram eigenvalue truncation rule
bandwidth_scale: median squared distance between representation-standardized landmark pairs, excluding values <=1e-14; use 1 when none remain
ridge_objective: mean squared training error plus alpha times squared coefficient norm; intercept unpenalized
selection_loss: exact empirical mean of squared losses of actual clipped binary64 predictions on all validation episodes; no target-variance normalization
decoder_tie_order: ascending bandwidth multiplier, then ascending ridge alpha; compare exact empirical loss fractions
shared_bank_selection: mean of separately best MEM and LOCAL validation losses within each bank; ties follow encoder_bank_order
raw_selection: independent minimum validation loss over the same 45 decoder configurations
failure_policy: unexpected fitting or finite-value failure stops the development run; no failed configuration is silently omitted
